answer: No, you should not be taking lisinopril. Your records show it was stopped on September 22, 2025, because it was causing a dry cough. Dr. Elena Marsh's note from that visit says to stop lisinopril and start losartan 50 mg daily. Your cough had resolved by your December 2025 visit, and at your June 15, 2026 visit the note says to continue your current medications. Losartan is the one listed as active now. The app that still shows lisinopril is most likely showing an old copy from an earlier import, made before it was stopped. Please don't restart lisinopril, and taking it together with losartan could be unsafe. If the app keeps showing it, ask your pharmacy or clinic to update the record. Also make sure lisinopril stays listed as something you couldn't tolerate because of the cough. If you're unsure, check with Dr. Marsh's office.
